caption: The drawing depicts a single object—a brown, pear-shaped powder flask with a metallic, cylindrical cap and a nozzle at the top. The flask is suspended by two twisted cords, anchoring from metal loops on either side of the neck. The body of the flask features an embossed image of a deer standing beside some foliage, rendered in relief and shaded to match the brown color of the flask, with darker and lighter tones to accentuate detail. The metal parts are colored in gold and brass tones. The background is plain and light beige, with no other objects or detailing, and a handwritten signature is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Powder Flask
